questions.correct_answer: It remains at rest or keeps moving at constant velocity
questions.explanation: Newton's First Law (the law of inertia) states that an object keeps its state of rest or uniform straight-line motion unless a net external force changes that state.
options: It slows down steadily until it stops
It accelerates in the direction of its motion
It remains at rest or keeps moving at constant velocity
It gradually changes direction toward the nearest mass
questions.question: According to Newton's First Law of motion, what happens to an object that has no net external force acting on it?

questions.explanation: Kinetic energy is the energy of motion and equals one half times the mass times the square of the speed, KE = ½mv². Because speed is squared, doubling the speed quadruples the kinetic energy.
questions.question: Which expression defines the kinetic energy of an object of mass m moving with speed v?

questions.correct_answer: The product of its mass and velocity
questions.explanation: Linear momentum is defined as p = mv, the product of an object's mass and its velocity. It is a vector quantity that points in the same direction as the velocity.
options: The product of its mass and velocity
The product of its mass and acceleration
The total energy it possesses due to its position
The force required to stop it in one second
